description: This file defines the AmbiguousSuccessParser class which extends AbstractParser to handle specific response parsing logic in AWS S3 SDK, particularly converting certain 200 status code responses into retryable errors; it manages ambiguous success cases for multipart upload operations.

classes.name: Aws\S3\AmbiguousSuccessParser
classes.description: A parser class for handling certain ambiguous successful responses (status code 200) from AWS S3, converting them into retryable errors, especially for multipart upload related commands.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with custom parser functions and optional exception class.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the response, checking for specific success responses, parsing potential errors, and throwing exceptions if needed.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Delegates the parsing of a member from a stream to the underlying parser.
